method: Recorded actions only: exact pinned engine own-unit and two-player market functions; no agent calls, no counterfactual policy, no new game. Row t+1 contains action for decision step t.
step_convention: Decision step t uses observation from replay row t and recorded action from row t+1. All late totals include step480 through718 inclusive.

candidate_ideas.evidence: At steps 480–718 inclusive, 141 MILK sold for $1,408 and 61 WOOL for $77; 182 STRAWBERRY sold for $35,892. Preserve actual fertilizer and egg benefits when comparing the service margin.
candidate_ideas.decision: Replace unconditional late feed/care/redundant animal delivery trips only when expected near-term product plus fertilizer value no longer pays wheat and labor; reassign existing hands to valuable harvest/delivery before reducing hires.
candidate_ideas.status: Candidate opportunity; no measured uplift or counterfactual outcome

candidate_ideas.candidate: Public-curve crash response with short-horizon sale targets

At 276 paid $240 for 6 WHEAT with 61 already in the shed; at 433 paid $172 for 4 FERTILIZER with 19 already in the shed.
